description: Edit the user's own footage into a finished video. Put what they asked for in its field (kind, length, style_id, the song, formats only when they asked for a shape); instructions holds only anything else, in their own words. Clypmint watches the footage itself: never describe it or ask the user how to edit. Read browse_styles once first: a saved style of theirs (own: true) that fits is the one to use. In ChatGPT attach the video as video; elsewhere leave it out and give the user the private upload link in the answer (15 minutes): editing starts when it lands. One upload per video: change a video already made with revise_video or a direct edit tool, never a new upload. No footage, an idea or a script? Use create_video. Cost: 3 credits to make, plus 1 for each started minute of footage and 1 for each started minute of finished video after the first, plus 2 for each extra hook, length or format and 2 for each clip; dry_run: true answers the cost and starts nothing.

asset_ids.description: Pictures or clips already in Clypmint to use (src_... from list_assets or save_clip).

asset_staging_keys.description: Pictures from import_asset to use, such as a logo (stg_...).

camera_sound.description: The footage's own sound. mute: only the song plays (the default for a montage with a song). keep: the camera sound stays (the default otherwise).

clips.description: Clips alone from one recording (no main film): podcasts, streams, long talks.

about.description: Topics to look for first, in plain words.

count.description: How many clips (1-30), or 'all' the good ones.

from_seconds.description: Look only after this second of the recording.

shape.description: source keeps the recording's shape; 9:16 cuts each clip vertical on the speaker.

to_seconds.description: Look only before this second of the recording.

dry_run.description: true: answer the credit cost and start nothing.

footage_from.description: A video_id already made from this footage: a new edit of it with no new upload (another kind, length or style). To change that video itself, use revise_video.

formats.description: Only when the user asked for a shape: 9:16 (vertical, TikTok, Reels, Shorts), 1:1 (square), 4:5, 16:9 (YouTube, widescreen), the main one first. Left out, nothing is cropped.

hooks.description: Openings to make (1-3): an ad gets 3 by default, the main cut counting as one.

instructions.description: Anything else the user asked for, in their own words, usually a sentence or two; not what has its own field. Never describe the footage or write rules.

kind.description: talking: someone speaks and their words lead (talking head, interview, podcast, tutorial). montage: pictures and music lead (sport, travel, events, b-roll); speech is not followed. Left out, Clypmint decides from the footage.

length.description: How long the finished video should be: "45-60 s" is {min_seconds: 45, max_seconds: 60}; "under a minute" is {max_seconds: 60}. Leave out when the user named no length.

music_staging_key.description: The song for this video, from import_asset (mp3, wav or m4a): a montage's soundtrack, or music under the speech.

names.description: Exact person, company and product names to spell right in this video.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

purpose.description: organic (a post), ad (three openings by default), youtube (horizontal), sales_page.

reference_mode.description: clone (default): a deep copy of the motion and captions; slower, uses a monthly style copy, then credits. match: fast and approximate, included.

reference_url.description: A video the user wants this edit to look like ("like this one"): a public link from Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Loom or LinkedIn. Clypmint copies and saves its style first. Leave style_id out.

shorts.description: Shorts to cut from the recording too (0-10), or 'all' the good ones.

song_upload.description: true when the user has a song file but no link: the upload link then takes the video and the song together. Leave out with music_staging_key.

sound_effects.description: true: sound effects on the edit.

source_url.description: A public https link to the footage (where links are open), instead of a file.

speaker_company.description: The speaker's company or business, spelled exactly for this video.

speaker_name.description: Who is talking, spelled right, e.g. "Dr. Ana Ruiz".

spellings.description: Heard-to-correct spellings for this video, e.g. {"KMAC":"KMAK"}.

style_id.description: A style id from browse_styles (my-... for the user's own).

style_version.description: A saved version of the user's own style; its newest when left out.

title.description: The video's name in the user's library.

video.description: The attached video file (ChatGPT). Leave out to get a private upload link instead.

name: edit_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint edit_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Edit a video
